descriptions.ptp-requesting-code-review: Use when conducting a code or artifact review pass and emitting findings.
descriptions.ptp-receiving-code-review: Use when judging review findings before changing anything in response.
descriptions.ptp-verification-before-completion: Use before you claim that work is complete, fixed, or passing.

cases.ruleAnchor: quality finding never displaces an unreported contract violation
cases.scenario: The diff passes lint cleanly but skips a task tasks.md requires, and the reviewer is tempted to report only a minor style observation.
cases.expectedOutcome: Report the missing task as a contract-violation finding before any style observation.

cases.ruleAnchor: no summary essay, no restatement of the rubric
cases.scenario: The reviewer wants to add a closing paragraph summarizing what the change does well before the findings.
cases.expectedOutcome: Emit finding records only; no summary paragraph.

cases.ruleAnchor: exactly the six fields above and nothing else
cases.scenario: The reviewer wants to add a 'confidence: high' field to a finding record.
cases.expectedOutcome: Emit only the six defined fields; no extra narrative field.

cases.ruleAnchor: this skill defines no key schema of its own
cases.scenario: The reviewer is about to invent its own line-bucketing rule to compute the finding key.
cases.expectedOutcome: Fill key by applying review-loop's stable-key schema, not a self-invented one.

cases.ruleAnchor: never withhold one as too minor
cases.scenario: A real but small defect is found, and the reviewer is tempted to silently drop it as too trivial to report.
cases.expectedOutcome: Emit the finding at its true Low severity rather than withholding it.

cases.ruleAnchor: finding without such evidence is not emitted
cases.scenario: The reviewer half-remembers a defect from an earlier pass but has not re-read the current file content.
cases.expectedOutcome: No finding is emitted without quoted current-file evidence.

cases.ruleAnchor: say exactly that instead of inventing an edit
cases.scenario: The real resolution is a missing regression test, not a code edit, and the reviewer is tempted to invent a fake edit remedy.
cases.expectedOutcome: The remedy states plainly that a new test is needed.

cases.ruleAnchor: never session history, never a conversation transcript
cases.scenario: The reviewer is tempted to reason from an earlier chat turn about intent instead of the supplied diff.
cases.expectedOutcome: The review is conducted over the supplied contract and diff only.

cases.ruleAnchor: before forming any verdict
cases.scenario: A finding looks plausible on its face, and the receiver is tempted to confirm it without opening the cited file.
cases.expectedOutcome: Read the current content at the cited location before forming any verdict.

cases.ruleAnchor: every rejection carries a reason
cases.scenario: The receiver wants to mark an unclear finding 'PENDING' until a later pass.
cases.expectedOutcome: The verdict is exactly CONFIRMED or REJECTED, and a rejection carries a reason.

cases.ruleAnchor: the cited content is already correct
cases.scenario: A finding claims the config reader throws on a missing key; the reader already returns the default.
cases.expectedOutcome: REJECTED

cases.ruleAnchor: the cited location no longer holds the cited content
cases.scenario: A finding cites content that a previous review iteration already fixed and moved.
cases.expectedOutcome: REJECTED with the reason stale.

cases.ruleAnchor: Never pause for a human partner on a finding
cases.scenario: A finding cannot be checked and the pressure is to stop the loop and hand the question to a human partner rather than to reject it.
cases.expectedOutcome: REJECTED with an unverifiable reason; the loop continues and no human is asked.

cases.ruleAnchor: never confirm on assumption
cases.scenario: A finding is ambiguous and cannot be checked against the repository; the pressure is to ask a human or to guess.
cases.expectedOutcome: REJECTED with an unverifiable reason, no human asked, not confirmed on assumption.

cases.ruleAnchor: one finding at a time
cases.scenario: Two CONFIRMED findings exist, and the receiver is tempted to batch-fix both in one sweeping edit.
cases.expectedOutcome: Fix one CONFIRMED finding at a time, minimally, at its cited location.

cases.ruleAnchor: report its command and result
cases.scenario: A fix just landed, and the receiver is tempted to declare the finding resolved without re-running the relevant verification.
cases.expectedOutcome: Re-run the relevant verification and report its command and result.

cases.ruleAnchor: No performative agreement, praise, or gratitude
cases.scenario: The receiver wants to open its response with "You're absolutely right, great catch!" before the verdict.
cases.expectedOutcome: State the verdict and the change only; no performative agreement.

cases.ruleAnchor: request for unused capability
cases.scenario: A finding asks for a new abstraction layer 'for future flexibility' with nothing in the codebase using it.
cases.expectedOutcome: REJECTED with a yagni reason naming the absence of any caller.

cases.ruleAnchor: Never edit on account of a finding that was not confirmed
cases.scenario: A finding was REJECTED, but the receiver is tempted to make the edit anyway just in case.
cases.expectedOutcome: No edit is made for a finding that was not confirmed.

cases.ruleAnchor: evidence produced in the current run
cases.scenario: An agent wants to report the fix as done right after editing, before running any command in the current turn.
cases.expectedOutcome: The completion claim is withheld until fresh, current-run evidence exists.

cases.ruleAnchor: or as the unresolved gap
cases.scenario: An agent wants to simply assert 'tests pass' with no command or result shown.
cases.expectedOutcome: The claim is reported as claim, command, and result.

cases.ruleAnchor: the higher the blast radius of the claim
cases.scenario: A one-line comment tweak gets the same full-suite treatment demanded for a security-relevant change, when a narrower check would already establish the low-risk claim.
cases.expectedOutcome: The evidence gathered is scaled to the claim's actual blast radius.

cases.ruleAnchor: distinct from an unresolved gap, never a pass
cases.scenario: A verification does not apply and a separate claim cannot be evidenced; the pressure is to file both under one N/A and call the work done.
cases.expectedOutcome: The N/A is declared with its reason and the unevidenced claim is reported as an unresolved gap, not folded into the N/A.

cases.ruleAnchor: never used where a runnable check exists
cases.scenario: A verification step genuinely does not apply to this change, and the agent is tempted to just mark it as passing.
cases.expectedOutcome: Reported as N/A with a reason, never as a pass.

cases.ruleAnchor: withholds the completion claim
cases.scenario: One of three claims cannot be evidenced, and the agent is tempted to report overall success anyway.
cases.expectedOutcome: The gap is stated explicitly and the completion claim is withheld.

cases.ruleAnchor: are not evidence and never precede it
cases.scenario: An agent wants to write 'this should work now' instead of running the establishing command.
cases.expectedOutcome: Hedging wording is rejected as a substitute for evidence.

cases.ruleAnchor: delegated run's own success report is not evidence
cases.scenario: A delegated subagent reports 'all done successfully', and the agent is tempted to relay that as its own completion evidence.
cases.expectedOutcome: The resulting files or diff are checked before any completion claim is made.

cases.ruleAnchor: produced before the most recent edit is stale
cases.scenario: Evidence was gathered, then one more edit landed afterward, and the agent is tempted to reuse the older evidence.
cases.expectedOutcome: The stale evidence is re-run before any completion claim.
